about_short_description.short_description: Eggnog AI is an artificial intelligence video platform that lets anyone create AI videos with consistent characters.

product.name: Eggnog Infinite
product.description: A platform feature that allows users to create AI videos with consistent characters, enabling the creation of continuous and coherent video content.

product.name: Create Characters
product.description: A tool for designing unique faces and outfits for characters to be used in AI-generated videos.

product.name: Storyboard
product.description: A feature that allows users to place their created characters into a sequence of scenes to outline the video narrative.

product.name: Generate Videos
product.description: A service that animates the storyboarded scenes to produce the final AI-generated video content.

product.name: Offer Wall
product.description: A feature that displays third-party advertisements offering virtual currency or gifts in exchange for completing advertisement offers.
